name: ampex-atr-master-glue
description: Transparent 2-bus / mastering tape polish on the UADx Ampex ATR-102 — REPRO, 30 IPS, Ampex 456, Cal +6, 1" tape, transformer ON (the even-harmonic gloss), modeled wow&flutter/crosstalk/hiss OFF for a clean master. The 1"/30-IPS combo = the tightest, most hi-fi format: leaner/controlled low end + a slightly open top, with essentially transparent dynamics (measured crest 25.0 dry -> 24.9). Width untouched (1.0) — never narrow a master. Drive harder for audible compression.
intended_for: a near-final stereo MIX / 2-bus, as a stage-5 color insert BEFORE render-mastered (the limiter). NOT a limiter.
plugin_build: uaudio_*.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the UAD *.component twin passes audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use it)

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> processed on projects/drums-kit/mix/bus_70s_balanced.wav (peak-normed), +6 dB drive; use to sanity-check a re-apply. centroid in [L] measure-spectrum units (dry == 4266). 30 IPS keeps the top open (Δ+62 vs dry) while 1" tightens the low (band_low 0.58 -> 0.53).

notes: input_gain_db drives the Record level. +6 assumes a ~-18..-23 LUFS bus; LOWER it for a hot near-0 dBFS master (the ATR's 0 VU = -12 dBFS, so a -18-referenced feed under-drives ~6 dB). Drive only until crest drops ~1-2 dB.

Transformer ON is the ATR's signature even-order (2nd) gloss — measured to lift centroid ~+356 Hz vs OFF (3515 -> 3871 at +10/15 IPS) and confirmed by a 1 kHz sine probe (H2 -55 ON vs -70 OFF; the odd 3rd is the tape, unchanged). Turn it OFF for the darkest, purest-tape tone.
30 IPS + 1" = the tightest, most extended/hi-fi mastering format (open top, leaner controlled bottom). For warmth/heft + a bigger head bump drop to 15 IPS and 1/2" (see ampex-atr-warm-2bus).
emphasis_eq is AES-locked at 30 IPS (NAB/CCIR has no effect there) — it only matters at 7.5/15 IPS.

auto_cal:true is asserted with the full speed/tape/cal/width set so the model re-aligns bias+EQ for THIS config. A partial param set that only changes ips can leave repro-EQ mis-calibrated for the old speed (measured ~-800 Hz darker at 30 IPS). Keep auto_cal near the end of the params.
wow&flutter/crosstalk/hiss OFF for a clean master; turn wow&flutter ON for vintage vibe.
